creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()

token_resp = apis.gmail.login(username='ka_ball@gmail.com', password=gmail_pw)
print(token_resp)

token = apis.gmail.login(username='ka_ball@gmail.com', password=[c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='gmail'][0])['access_token']
print('token prefix', token[:20])

token = [c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='gmail'][0]
access_token = apis.gmail.login(username='ka_ball@gmail.com', password=token)['access_token']
page_limit=20
read_flag=False
all_threads=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    resp = apis.gmail.show_inbox_threads(access_token=access_token, read=read_flag, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    threads = resp.get('email_threads', [])
    print('page', page_index, 'returned', len(threads))
    if not threads:
        break
    all_threads.extend(threads)
    page_index += 1
print('total unread inbox threads:', len(all_threads))
print('sample first 3:', all_threads[:3])
